sloka: त्वत् कृते हि मया सर्वम् इदम् एवम् विधम् कृतम् ।मा शोकम् मा च सम्तापम् धैर्यमाश्रय पुत्रक ॥२-७२-५३॥
transliteration: tvat kṛte hi mayā sarvam idam evam vidham kṛtam ।mā śokam mā ca samtāpam dhairyamāśraya putraka ॥2-72-53॥

translations.english: ﻿ My son, give up sorrow and agony and take recourse to courage. This city as well as the kingdom, free from all obstacles, is under your control.
